integrity: Mathematical proof with standard-library exact checker; finite tests are corroboration, not the proof. Historical priority requires independent examination.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for a static binary plant–pollinator network with uniform fixed-count pollinator loss and no rewiring or feedback. Does not establish an ecological field prediction, individual intervention recommendation, or equivalent-theorem absence in uninspected probability literature.
title: A one-switch sign law for paired coextinction during fixed-count pollinator loss
